title: Release Susi 0.21.45
goal: Publish 0.21.45 with: the in-place installed launcher (150 ms -> ~32 ms per command, and captured susi start returns), state-only susi status (3.7 s before), non-blocking MCP tools/list (10.3 s cold before), public /health and standard A2A JSON-RPC codes, path-free model ids, the susi-conformance host contract suite, parallel leaf-service boot, the open-core boundary, enterprise multi-tenancy and Kubernetes packaging moved to commercial apps, and the CI fixes that made 0.21.44's release suite red.
